name: Openplanet Control
description: Detects Openplanet and its signature mode, enforces which modes are allowed and shows admins what every player uses.
author: TMControlPanel

allowOpenplanet.title: Allow Openplanet
allowOpenplanet.description: When off, every player with Openplanet is treated as a violation.

enforceSignatures.title: Enforce signature modes
enforceSignatures.description: Only allow the signature modes below.

customSignatures.title: Custom signature modes
customSignatures.description: Competition profiles not in the list above, as shown in brackets in the tool info (for example TMWT).

minimumVersion.title: Minimum Openplanet version
minimumVersion.description: For example 1.27.0. Leave empty to allow any version.

enforcement.title: Action on a violation
enforcement.description: Warn only sends a chat message. Spectator forces the player to spectate until they fix it. Kick also kicks them after the delay.

exemptAdmins.title: Exempt panel admins
exemptAdmins.description: Server admins are never forced to spectate or kicked.

checkInterval.title: Recheck interval (seconds)
checkInterval.description: How often clients look for a changed signature mode while playing. 0 checks only when joining.

helpText:
Checks every player's Openplanet signature mode.
Commands:
/openplanet - (admins) show the signature modes players use
